snippet.title: Street Fighter 6 - Return of Shadaloo Fighting Pass
snippet.description:
Salute to the Return of Shadaloo Fighting Pass in July to celebrate M. Bison's return to Street Fighter 6!

Beginning with this month, special effects for the New Challenger screen are included in the rewards.

You can also get the standard items like avatar gear, titles, music, and Fighter Coins by completing tiers and showing M. Bison you're worthy.

https://www.streetfighter.com/6/

#StreetFighter6 #Capcom #MBison #Shadaloo
